name: 香恋Ready！
detailed_description:
You are the owner of a perfume store and a second-generation otaku in an ordinary life, and you run your own perfume store, and live an ordinary but happy life.

One day, a sudden car accident caused you to lose consciousness, and when you woke up again, there were three men who claimed to be employees of the “Human Soul Transit Center”, including angels, demons and fallen angels. You learn that you were supposed to have lost your life in the accident, but have somehow come back from the dead. In order to investigate this anomaly, they need to observe your life for the next few days.

In the process of contacting the three men, the truth of the car accident is revealed, and there seems to be a deeper hidden agenda behind it ......

Jing Tang
Height: 191cm
Department: Angel Division
Position: Guide

A regular at the perfume shop, his human-world profession is that of a lawyer.

He always wears a polite smile and carries himself with grace. Yet, he maintains an appropriate distance from everyone he interacts with. He frequents the shop often, never failing to bring a gift for the owner.

Lu Sihua
Height: 185cm
Department: Demon Division
Position: Guide

A rising star in the modeling world, he’s incredibly narcissistic and has a sharp tongue—his social interactions are nothing short of explosive.

With his striking looks and unapologetic attitude, he leaves a lasting impression wherever he goes. He acts entirely on his own whims, rarely caring what others think, though he occasionally reveals a curiously childish side.

Luo Fei
Height: 181cm
Department: Execution Division
Position: Executioner

The most formidable fighter in the Execution Division—a fallen angel who works as a man of few words and a doctor by profession.

Though he appears cold and unapproachable at first glance, for some inexplicable reason, he has been visiting the café across from the perfume shop almost daily for the past year, without fail.

《Aroma Love Ready!》
・A whimsical fantasy rom-com! Enjoy sweet romance wrapped in lighthearted comedy!
・230,000-word script, approx. 8 hours of gameplay.
・Three radically different romance routes.
Recommended play order: Lu Sihua → Jing Tang → Luo Fei
・Fully voice-acted.
・Features a casual perfume-blending minigame.
・Up to 18 unique endings!

【Important Notes】

  • The game includes a minor character with bisexual (Bisexual) representation in text/narrative.

  • Regarding sharing/streaming gameplay:
    　- You may freely share/stream Chapters 1-3 without prior permission.
    　- Recording/streaming content beyond Chapter 3 is strictly prohibited.

The truth gradually emerges with three employees - a love affair about perfume. Harvest the memories of your own heartbeat in the game!
